title: Limb Chopper
description:
Limb Chopper is a third-person PS1 style survival slasher horror/shooter set in the underbelly of Los Angeles in the 1980s. You are Detective Palmer, a loose cannon who doesn't play by the rules. You're on a mission to hunt down and apprehend a hulking masked killer before he butchers more innocent citizens.

Use your detective skills to uncover various clues to his whereabouts. Talk to various potential witnesses to track down the killer known as "Limb Chopper." Gun down dubious thugs that stand in your way. Prevent further massacres that plague the streets of Los Angeles. Keep your wits about you as you navigate the seedy cesspool of LA...or it's your funeral.Current Features
• Third-person horror/shooter 
• Inventory management 
• RPG style dialogue system 
• Rad, drivable car 
• Large, open map 
• Weapon system and inventory 
• numerous death animations 
• Original soundtrack capturing the essence of the 80s 
• Relentless killer who also has an arsenal of different weapons and his own vehicle to stalk his prey 
• Memorable cast of side character tropes from 80s slasher films
description_short: Find the masked killer responsible for butchering innocent citizens of 1980s Los Angeles...before he finds you. Uncover clues about the killer's whereabouts to save the city and put the Limb Chopper away for good.
